description: Extract the text of a Word document (.docx) into a .txt file, keeping lists and tables (cells separated by tabs). The text is also returned (up to 20,000 characters). Old .doc files are not supported.

file.description: Absolute path of the input file (a path starting with ~ is also accepted).

output.description: Absolute path of the result file. Default: next to the input, with a name that never overwrites an existing file.

name: word_to_text
title: Word en texte
